components.name: Cobbler Batter
ingredients: 1/4 cup melted butter or vegetable oil
directions: In a medium bowl, stir together flour, baking powder, salt, sugar, and spices.
In a separate bowl, stir together pumpkin, milk, melted butter, and vanilla.
Pour wet ingredients into dry and mix to create a thick batter.
Pour into a small 8-inch casserole dish with high sides.

components.name: Topping
directions: Stir sugars and pecans together and spread evenly over the batter.
Pour hot water over everything WITHOUT stirring.
Bake at 350°F for 40 minutes or until middle is set.
Cool 5–10 minutes before serving. Serve with vanilla ice cream and additional pecans.
